intent: Name what one item row is, in a single line.
typical_uses: The one-line name of an Item, such as a file name or a person's name

dont_use_when.situation: The headline of a bounded panel
The headline of a placeholder for a region with nothing to show

invariants.text: ItemTitle renders a div in the label weight that never wraps: it is as wide as its text up to the space available, and text past that width is clipped. It has no heading role.

good.title: A short name above its description

bad.title: The explanation folded into the title
bad.code:
<ItemContent>
  <ItemTitle>Jane Doe, owner of the workspace since March</ItemTitle>
</ItemContent>
bad.why: ItemTitle stays on one line and clips what does not fit, so the end of the sentence is lost in a narrow row; the supporting text belongs in ItemDescription, which wraps to two lines.
